description: Check whether we cover a destination before choosing a plan — answers "do you work in X?", "can I get mobile data / a SIM card in X?", "is X supported?". Returns yes/no, how many plans cover it, and the cheapest unlimited and fixed-data plan as examples. Use search_esim_plans or find_cheapest_plan for the full list.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the destination, e.g. 'JP', 'US'

currency.description: ISO currency for prices, default the store currency

name: check_destination_coverage
title: Check destination coverage
